requirements.title: Patient Billing
requirements.description: Ability to generate itemized billing statements, accept online payments, and set up payment plans for balances over $500
requirements.user_story: As a patient, I want to easily access and pay my bills online, so that I can manage my healthcare expenses efficiently
acceptance_criteria: Itemized billing statements are available in portal with PDF download
Online payment options include credit card, HSA/FSA card, and bank transfer

test_steps.expected_result: Billing statement is displayed with PDF download option

test_scenarios: Online payment processing for credit card and HSA/FSA card

requirements.title: Claims Processing
requirements.description: Ability to automate claim submission to insurance payers, track claim status, and manage denials with appeal letter templates
requirements.user_story: As a healthcare provider, I want to streamline claims processing and reduce denials, so that I can improve revenue cycle efficiency
acceptance_criteria: Automated claim submission to insurance payers via EDI 837 format
Claim status tracking is visible to staff

test_steps.expected_result: Claim status is updated in system

test_scenarios: Claim submission and status tracking for multiple payers
assumptions: EDI 837 format is supported by payers
ambiguities: Handling of unsupported payer EDI transactions

requirements.title: Telehealth Services
requirements.description: Provide telehealth services for remote patient consultations
requirements.user_story: As a patient, I want to consult with my healthcare provider remotely, so that I can receive medical care from the comfort of my own home
assumptions: Telehealth system is available and accessible

requirements.title: Patient Portal
requirements.description: Patient dashboard with appointment scheduling, medication lists, and lab results
requirements.user_story: As a patient, I want to access my medical information and schedule appointments, so that I can manage my healthcare
acceptance_criteria: Shows medication lists and lab results

test_steps.expected_result: Patient portal displays with appointment schedule and medical information

requirements.title: Video Consultation
requirements.description: Integrated video consultation using Zoom Healthcare API with HIPAA BAA, virtual waiting room with estimated wait time and position in queue, and screen sharing capability
requirements.user_story: As a healthcare provider, I want to conduct video consultations with patients, so that I can provide remote care
acceptance_criteria: Video consultation integrates with Zoom Healthcare API
Virtual waiting room displays estimated wait time and position in queue
Screen sharing capability allows providers to review lab results with patients

test_steps.expected_result: Video consultation starts with virtual waiting room

assumptions: Provider has Zoom Healthcare API account

requirements.title: Insurance Verification Workflow
requirements.description: 1. Receive patient information → 2. Send insurance eligibility request via EDI 270 → 3. Receive eligibility response via EDI 271 → 4. Display co-pay and deductible amounts
requirements.user_story: As a healthcare provider, I want to verify patient insurance eligibility in real-time, so that I can ensure accurate billing and reduce claim denials
acceptance_criteria: Co-pay and deductible amounts displayed correctly
test_scenarios: Happy path with valid patient information
Error path with invalid patient information
assumptions: EDI 270/271 transactions are supported by the payer
ambiguities: What happens if eligibility response is delayed or not received?

requirements.title: Payment Processing Workflow
requirements.description: 1. View outstanding balance → 2. Select payment method → 3. Set up payment plan
requirements.user_story: As a patient, I want to pay my outstanding balance, so that I can settle my account.
acceptance_criteria: Payment method selection updates payment form
ambiguities: What happens if the payment is declined?

requirements.title: Telehealth Visit End-to-End Workflow
requirements.description: Patient logs in → Pre-consultation device check → Patient enters virtual waiting room → Provider joins and consults patient → Visit notes and orders documented
requirements.user_story: As a patient, I want to have a seamless telehealth video consultation experience, so that I can receive remote medical care
acceptance_criteria: Patient can join video visit and consult with provider
Provider can document visit notes and orders in real-time

test_steps.expected_result: Patient and provider connected in HIPAA-compliant session

test_scenarios: Error Path EP-1: Video drops during consultation
ambiguities: What happens if provider is unavailable during scheduled consultation?

requirements.title: Patient-Initiated Prescription Refill Workflow
requirements.description: Patient requests refill → System checks refill count → Refill request sent to pharmacy or prescribing provider
requirements.user_story: As a patient, I want to easily request prescription refills, so that I can receive my medications in a timely manner
acceptance_criteria: Patient can request refill and system checks refill count
Refill request sent to pharmacy or prescribing provider

test_steps.expected_result: Refill request sent to pharmacy or prescribing provider

test_scenarios: Decision Point DP-1: Controlled substance requires additional verification
assumptions: Pharmacy and prescribing provider integrations are accurate
ambiguities: What happens if patient has no refills remaining and prescribing provider is unavailable?

requirements.title: Visit to Bill Payment Lifecycle Workflow
requirements.description: Charge entry completed → EDI 837 Professional claim submitted → Claim acknowledgment received → EOB received and patient statement generated
requirements.user_story: As a patient, I want to receive accurate and timely billing statements, so that I can pay my medical bills efficiently
acceptance_criteria: Charge entry completed and EDI 837 claim submitted
Claim acknowledgment received and EOB processed

test_steps.expected_result: EDI 837 claim submitted and claim acknowledgment received

test_scenarios: Error Path EP-2: Claim denied and denial management workflow triggered
ambiguities: What happens if patient disputes billing statement?

requirements.title: Video Consultation with Zoom Healthcare API
